text: Silicon Mach-Zehnder modulators use the plasma dispersion (free-carrier) effect. A typical Vpi*L figure of merit for a silicon PN carrier-depletion phase shifter is about:
explanation: Silicon PN depletion modulators have Vpi*L around 10-30 V*mm. 2-3 V*mm is the Pockels-effect value for thin-film lithium niobate (LNOI); 0.02 V*mm is a plasmonic slot modulator; 500 V*mm is unrealistically large. Smaller Vpi*L means a shorter device or lower drive voltage.
